operator-walkthrough.ref: Q-23 phase 12 (2026-10-01, branch nickstire/q23-phase12-gateway-one-rule). What the operator sees: (1) The gateway pill in the Outreach Hub header, on SMS and on Tire Orders reads 'Checking gateway...' while its first read loads (it said 'Gateway offline'). It no longer flashes 'Gateway: not configured' while the config read is still loading. When a background refresh fails it keeps showing the last good reading (Live or offline) instead of turning grey 'status unknown'. A failed read with nothing cached still says 'Gateway status unknown'. (2) Admin > Intelligence HQ > Data freshness: when the SMS gateway refresh fails, the row keeps the last reading, adds 'Last good read; the latest refresh failed.' and counts toward 'N need a look'. (3) Admin > Settings > Status: the 'N of 8 checks could not run' banner lists 'SMS gateway health' again when that query fails with cached data. The F25e pill says 'status unknown · the status read failed' when our own query failed with nothing cached. The red 'F25e shop SMS gateway offline' alert now says texts wait in the queue until the gateway checks back in (after-hours auto-replies are dropped instead), not that they fall through to Twilio. (4) Outreach Hub brief: the live line reads 'F25e shop gateway offline (texts queue until the phone checks back in)' instead of 'offline (Twilio fallback active)'.
